description: Open-loop scoop trajectory, no slip randomization, ball fixed 1.0 m dead ahead, robot and ball at rest. 96.0% success over 150 identical runs (ball in net, held >= 1 s at the end of a 4 s window).

trajectory.v_unit: m/s, constant forward command from t=0
trajectory.t_lift_unit: s, arm lift start (ball first touches the net at ~0.73 s)
trajectory.d_unit: rad raise above the initial pose
trajectory.t_brake_unit: s after t_lift, then vx command 0
